core_obligations: Reduce the first statement to the localisations at maximal ideals (proof lines 4966-4971).
Quote the discrete valuation ring case to conclude that flat modules over a Dedekind domain are torsion free (proof lines 4969-4971).
Derive finite local freeness of a finite torsion free module from the projective criterion and the first statement (proof lines 4973-4975).
For a principal ideal domain, embed a finite torsion free module into a finite free module (proof lines 4979-4981).
Argue by induction on the rank, splitting off the intersection with a summand and concluding that the module is an extension of finite free modules (proof lines 4982-4993).
proof_roadmap: Flat equals torsion free, locally (proof lines 4966-4971).
Finite locally free via the projective criterion (proof lines 4973-4975).
Finite free over a principal ideal domain by induction on the rank (proof lines 4979-4993).
difficulty_reason: The lemma collects three facts about modules over a Dedekind domain: flatness is equivalent to torsion freeness, finite torsion free modules are finite locally free, and over a principal ideal domain finite torsion free modules are free. The first part reduces to the local rings of the domain, which are discrete valuation rings, where the equivalence is known, and the reduction is justified by the local nature of flatness and of torsion. The second part combines this with the characterisation of finite projective modules as finitely presented and flat. The third part embeds a finite torsion free module into a finite free module and argues by induction on the rank, splitting off the intersection with the first summand to obtain an extension of finite free modules.
